_comment: Template for a new chain. scripts/fill-subgraph-config.js copies this to <network>.json and substitutes NETWORK_NAME, the *_ADDRESS placeholders and DEPLOY_BLOCK from deployments/<network>/. Not a network config itself; the leading underscore keeps it out of the chain list. lender_commitment is enabled here because packages/subgraph cannot build without it: src/lender-commitment/mapping.ts imports generated/LenderCommitmentForwarder, which codegen only emits when that data source exists, and the same mapping file is used by the always-on Alpha data source. A chain with no plain LenderCommitmentForwarder makes fill-subgraph-config fail loudly on the missing artifact, which is the cue to disable it deliberately rather than discover it at graph build.
name: teller-v2-NETWORK_NAME
